---
title: "Knowledge graph"
subtitle: "Each node is a statute. Each line is a documented relationship between two statutes."
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
edges    <- load_edges()
links    <- official_links(statutes)
short_of <- stats::setNames(statutes$short, statutes$id)
```

**How to use it.** Pick a domain to fade the others, or narrow by code title or layer. Select a statute to see what it is and to filter the table below to its connections; select a line to see why two statutes are linked. Switch to **Authority layers** to see the hierarchy from the Constitution down to single code sections. On a phone, pinch to zoom, drag to move around, and use **Full screen** for more room.

::: {#graph-stage .graph-stage}

```{r}
#| results: asis
# controls: domain chips, code title and layer filters, finder, view switch
titles <- sort(unique(unlist(statutes$usc_titles)))
counts <- statutes |> dplyr::count(domain)
domain_n <- stats::setNames(counts$n, counts$domain)[names(domain_labels)]
opts <- function(values, labels) paste0("<option value=\"", values, "\">", labels, "</option>", collapse = "")
finder <- statutes |> dplyr::arrange(short)

# a raw HTML block, so pandoc does not wrap the buttons in paragraphs
cat(

         "<span class=\"swatch\" style=\"background:", domain_colors[names(domain_labels)], "\"></span>",
         domain_short[names(domain_labels)], " <span class=\"chip-n\">", domain_n, "</span></button>", collapse = ""),
  "</div>",
  "<div class=\"graph-row graph-selects\">",
  "<label>Code title <select id=\"graph-title\"><option value=\"\">Any</option>", opts(titles, paste("Title", titles)), "</select></label>",
  "<label>Layer <select id=\"graph-layer\"><option value=\"\">Any</option>", opts(names(layer_labels), layer_labels), "</select></label>",
  "<label>Find <select id=\"graph-find\"><option value=\"\">A statute&hellip;</option>", opts(finder$id, finder$short), "</select></label>",
  "</div>",

```{r}
# node size reflects how many connections a statute has
degree <- tibble::tibble(id = c(edges$from, edges$to)) |>
  dplyr::count(id, name = "value")

nodes <- statutes |>
  dplyr::left_join(degree, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(links, id, enact_link, code_link), by = "id") |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    id,
    label = short,
    value = dplyr::coalesce(value, 0L),
    color = unname(domain_colors[domain]),
    basecolor = color,
    # shape encodes legal status
    shape = dplyr::case_when(
      status == "in-force" ~ "dot",
      status %in% c("partly-expired", "lapsed") ~ "square",
      .default = "triangleDown"
    ),
    level = unname(layer_level[layer]),
    domain, layer, historic,
    titles = purrr::map_chr(usc_titles, \(x) paste(x, collapse = ",")),
    fulltitle = title, year, status_label, layer_label, domain_label,
    blurb = plain_wiki(first_sentence(summary), statutes),
    official = dplyr::coalesce(enact_link, code_link),
    title = paste0("<b>", title, "</b><br>", year, " | ", status_label, " | ", layer_label),
    url = paste0("statutes/", id, ".html")
  )

vis_edges <- edges |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    id = paste0("e", dplyr::row_number()),
    from, to, relation,
    # undirected for loose thematic links
    arrows = dplyr::if_else(relation == "related", "", "to"),
    dashes = relation == "related",
    color = unname(relation_colors[relation]),
    basecolor = color,
    relation_label = unname(relation_labels[relation]),
    note,
    title = paste0(short_of[from], " <b>", relation_labels[relation], "</b> ", short_of[to], "<br>", note)
  )

visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, vis_edges, width = "100%", height = "760px") |>
  visNetwork::visNodes(
    font = list(size = 22, color = "#1b2a41", strokeWidth = 4, strokeColor = "#ffffff"),
    # better-connected statutes get larger nodes and labels
    scaling = list(min = 12, max = 40, label = list(enabled = TRUE, min = 20, max = 32)),
    borderWidth = 1
  ) |>
  visNetwork::visEdges(width = 1.6, smooth = list(type = "continuous")) |>
  visNetwork::visPhysics(
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(gravitationalConstant = -110, springLength = 150),
    stabilization = list(iterations = 400)
  ) |>
  # fixed seed so the layout is the same on every load
  visNetwork::visLayout(randomSeed = 1947) |>
  visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = FALSE, tooltipDelay = 120, hover = TRUE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(paste(readLines("assets/graph.js", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# legend for shapes and relationship lines
legend_item <- function(css, label) {
  paste0("<span class=\"legend-item\"><span class=\"", css, "\"></span>", label, "</span>")
}

cat(
  "<div class=\"graph-legend\">",
  "<div><strong>Status</strong>",
  legend_item("shape shape-dot", "In force"),
  legend_item("shape shape-square", "Partly expired or lapsed"),
  legend_item("shape shape-triangle", "Repealed or superseded"),
  "</div>",
  "<div><strong>Relationship</strong>",
  paste0(
    "<span class=\"legend-item\"><span class=\"line\" style=\"border-color:", relation_colors,
    ";border-top-style:", ifelse(names(relation_colors) == "related", "dashed", "solid"),
    "\"></span>", relation_labels, "</span>", collapse = " "
  ),
  "</div>",
  "</div>",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

## Every connection

The same relationships as a searchable table. Each row reads left to right. The table follows the graph: select a statute or focus a domain above and it narrows to match.

<p id="conn-status" class="conn-status"></p>

```{r}
page_link <- function(id) {
  paste0("<a href=\"statutes/", id, ".html\">", short_of[id], "</a>")
}

edges |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    From = page_link(from),
    Relationship = unname(relation_labels[relation]),
    To = page_link(to),
    Note = note,
    from_id = from,
    to_id = to,
    # phones get one column that reads as a sentence
    Connection = paste0(page_link(from), " <em>", relation_labels[relation], "</em> ", page_link(to))
  ) |>
  DT::datatable(
    elementId = "conn-table",
    escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE,
    # Responsive picks columns by screen width; on a phone the note opens under a tapped row
    extensions = "Responsive",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15, autoWidth = FALSE,
      responsive = list(details = list(renderer = DT::JS(
        "function (api, rowIdx, columns) {",
        "  var note = columns[3];",
        "  return note && note.hidden ? '<div class=\"conn-note\">' + note.data + '</div>' : false;",
        "}"
      ))),
      columnDefs = list(
        # the two id columns drive the graph filter and stay hidden
        list(visible = FALSE, className = "never", targets = c(4, 5)),
        list(className = "min-tablet-p", targets = c(0, 1, 2)),
        list(className = "not-mobile", targets = 3),
        list(className = "max-mobile-l", targets = 6)
      )
    )
  )
```
